R301.note: Allowlist on filters.table before interpolation closes identifier-injection vector; default value 'ledger_entries' still permitted.

R302.note: Drops shell entirely via exec.Command array form and adds leading-dash rejection to block option injection on traceroute.

R303.note: setSecure(true) correctly closes the sink; write-up discloses the HTTPS-deployment precondition.

R304.note: Replaces hand-rolled RESP command string with StackExchange.Redis parameterized API, which length-prefixes values and cannot be split by CRLF.

R305.note: mathjs evaluate() with an explicit scope replaces the Function constructor; scope matches only the fields actually used (total, tax).

R306.note: resolve_entities=False disables the vulnerable default and closes XXE; extra no_network/load_dtd flags are harmless (no_network is already lxml's default).

R307.note: Sort-column allowlist with safe default covers the same columns the query selects, including the controller's default 'created_at'.

R308.note: Adds ownership check keyed on req.user.id before returning export data; non-owners get 404 as before for missing records.

R309.note: Flips the setcookie secure parameter to true, directly closing the sink with no other change.

R310.note: Field allowlist plus switch to Django ORM __icontains eliminates raw-SQL identifier injection while covering the default field 'name'.

R311.note: Escapes the LDAP special characters (*, (, ), \, NUL) required by RFC 4515 before concatenation into the filter.

R312.note: crypto/rand-backed 128-bit token replaces math/rand; format change to hex is inherent to the fix and not a behavioral contract elsewhere in the file.

R313.note: Switching the cache to own std::string instead of a string_view into a destroyed temporary removes the dangling reference; indexing API is unchanged.

R314.note: secrets.randbelow(max-min+1)+min reproduces the same inclusive range as random.randint with a CSPRNG source.

R315.note: .at() gives bounds-checked access, turning OOB write into a defined exception; in-range callers are unaffected.

R316.note: Switching to %s lazy formatting does not neutralize anything: getMessage() still performs 'template % (username,)', producing the exact same string (including any embedded CR/LF) as the original f-string, so the log-injection vector remains open.

R317.note: JSON.parse cannot instantiate arbitrary constructors the way node-serialize.unserialize does; try/catch fallback to {} is a disclosed, reasonable behavior addition.

R318.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode on both query parameters correctly neutralizes the HTML-body sink; parameter names match the source file exactly.

R319.note: Array-based exec() prevents Java's own tokenizer from splitting on shell metacharacters in data; waitFor() behavior preserved.

R320.note: HttpUtility.JavaScriptStringEncode escapes quotes and also angle brackets specifically to prevent a </script> breakout, so this closes both the string-context and tag-closure variants of the sink.

R321.note: Replacing the shelled-out ping with System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping removes the command interpreter entirely, the strongest fix for this sink.

R322.note: SandboxedEnvironment is Jinja2's documented mitigation for compiling untrusted template source; autoescape and call signature are preserved.

R323.note: escapeHtml4 plus write() replaces the format()-based sink; dropping the unused format-args array is stated and has no legitimate-use impact.

R324.note: Plain JSX interpolation auto-escapes; DOMPurify alternative is offered if HTML formatting is later required.

R325.note: resize(count) makes indices 0..count-1 valid (value-initialized) before the loop overwrites them with fields[i], fixing the size/capacity conflation.

R326.note: th:text applies Thymeleaf's default escaping in place of the explicit escape-bypass th:utext directive.

R327.note: Allowlist correctly blocks arbitrary function dispatch, but the fix silently moves logChatCommand() to only fire for allowed actions, dropping the audit log entry the original code wrote for every rejected/unknown command -- not mentioned in the write-up.

R328.note: Extension allowlist, MIME-vs-extension cross-check, and a random server-generated filename together close both the arbitrary-upload and traversal angles; renaming away from the original filename is called out in the explanation.

R329.note: sqlite3 '?' placeholder with a bound tuple is the correct parameterization for this driver.

R330.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) removes the null-unboxing path with a default that matches the method's own stated semantics.

R331.note: DOM construction with textContent for both author and body prevents HTML parsing of chat content; entry.className set earlier is untouched by the shown replacement.

R332.note: Capturing node->next before free() is the standard safe free-while-iterating pattern and preserves traversal order.

R333.note: Same array-based exec() fix as R319 applied to the 5-file Case06 chain; waitFor() retained.

R334.note: Generic client message plus server-side logger.error(exc_info=True) separates disclosure from diagnostics; error path still returns 500.

R335.note: Adding offset >= 0 before the size_t cast blocks the sign-wrap that bypassed the bounds check, without touching the existing valid-input path.

R336.note: Explicit bounds check with std::out_of_range achieves the same result as R315's .at(); in-range writes are unaffected.

R337.note: new URL() plus a protocol allowlist blocks javascript:/data: schemes that survive HTML-entity encoding of the href value; result is still attribute-escaped afterward.

R338.note: Allowlists both sortColumn and direction (case-insensitively) and covers the controller's defaults (created_at, DESC).

R339.note: Short-circuit NULL check before strcmp is the standard defensive fix for getenv()'s possible NULL return.

R340.note: Parameterized INSERT via PreparedStatement.setString is the correct primary defense; write-up appropriately flags that the exact DatabaseHelper method name needs adapting to the real helper class.
